The house rules

It's all about who.

  1. Set the table. Me, Sarah, Jeter, and Eric are ready. Agree on 1–5 laps and choose one or two dice.
  2. Meet the deck. Each person has exactly 15 questions with generated sample answers based on their interests. Play immediately or use Edit our cards to personalize them.
  3. Roll and move. Move clockwise by the dice total. Every space draws a question and answer assigned to someone else.
  4. Guess who would say it. A correct guess keeps your new position. A wrong guess sends you back two spaces, with no extra question.
  5. Make it around. The first player to complete the agreed laps wins after their question is resolved. On the final lap, movement stops at the finish; a wrong guess sends you back two spaces.

You never receive your own card. Used cards return when no unseen cards remain for the current player. Moving backward across Start reduces your lap progress; you can't move behind the original starting position.

Everyone can discuss the question, but only the player taking the turn guesses. The generated answers are imaginary examples, not verified personal facts. Personalized cards can use your real answers. Play on one device together; refreshing restores the original deck and starts over.
